<style>
/* ============================================================
   Grafana Custom Theme
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- Typography ---------- */
body,
button,
input,
select,
textarea,
table,
[class*="panel-title"],
[class*="panel-content"] {
  font-family: Inter, "Noto Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif !important;
}

/* ---------- Dark Mode ---------- */
body[class*="theme-dark"],
body:not([class*="theme-light"]) {
  --ui-bg: #0b1824;
  --ui-card: #0f1d2a;
  --ui-border: rgba(198, 219, 234, 0.14);
  --ui-input: #20324b;
  --ui-primary: #268dff;
  --ui-fg: #e6edf7;
  --ui-muted-fg: rgba(182, 199, 224, 0.58);
  --ui-destructive: #f0685f;
  --ui-radius: 2px;
  --ui-radius-button: 6px;
  --ui-radius-input: 2px;
  --ui-radius-menu: 2px;
  --ui-radius-menu-item: 4px;
  --ui-radius-panel: 10px;
  --ui-radius-select: 6px;
  --ui-table-hover: rgba(198, 219, 234, 0.04);
  --ui-card-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), 0 8px 20px 0 rgba(2, 7, 12, 0.42);
  --ui-select-fill: #0f1d2a;
  --ui-select-border: rgba(198, 219, 234, 0.2);
  --ui-select-hover-border: rgba(173, 192, 224, 0.42);
  --ui-select-outstanding: #268dff;
  --ui-select-hover-fill: rgba(158, 179, 214, 0.18);
  --ui-select-selected-fill: rgba(38, 141, 255, 0.06);
  --ui-select-focus-ring: 0 0 0 4px rgba(38, 141, 255, 0.18);
  --ui-select-shadow: 0px 1px 2px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
  --ui-menu-fill: #0f1d2a;
  --ui-menu-border: rgba(198, 219, 234, 0.14);
  --ui-menu-shadow: 0px 18px 42px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48), 0px 0px 0px 1px rgba(173, 192, 224, 0.12);
  --ui-select-text: #e6edf7;
  --ui-select-text-strong: #f6f9fe;
}

/* ---------- Light Mode ---------- */
body[class*="theme-light"] {
  --ui-bg: #edf0f7;
  --ui-card: #ffffff;
  --ui-border: rgba(12, 40, 73, 0.12);
  --ui-input: #edf1f4;
  --ui-primary: #0080ff;
  --ui-fg: #00122e;
  --ui-muted-fg: rgba(44, 56, 82, 0.6);
  --ui-destructive: #f0483e;
  --ui-radius: 2px;
  --ui-radius-button: 6px;
  --ui-radius-input: 2px;
  --ui-radius-menu: 2px;
  --ui-radius-menu-item: 4px;
  --ui-radius-panel: 10px;
  --ui-radius-select: 6px;
  --ui-table-hover: rgba(36, 41, 46, 0.04);
  --ui-card-shadow: 0 4px 14px 0 rgba(12, 40, 73, 0.06);
  --ui-select-fill: #ffffff;
  --ui-select-border: rgba(12, 40, 73, 0.24);
  --ui-select-hover-border: rgba(107, 128, 167, 0.6);
  --ui-select-outstanding: #0080ff;
  --ui-select-hover-fill: rgba(211, 218, 235, 0.6);
  --ui-select-selected-fill: rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.04);
  --ui-select-focus-ring: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.16);
  --ui-select-shadow: 0px 1px 2px -1px rgba(44, 56, 82, 0.18);
  --ui-menu-fill: #ffffff;
  --ui-menu-border: rgba(211, 218, 235, 0.6);
  --ui-menu-shadow: 0px 12px 40px 0px rgba(45, 58, 86, 0.3), 0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(107, 125, 153, 0.18);
  --ui-select-text: #00122e;
  --ui-select-text-strong: #1d326c;
}

/* ---------- Global Background ---------- */
body,
.main-view,
[class*="page-wrapper"]>div>div:first-child {
  background-color: var(--ui-bg) !important;
}

/* ---------- Panel Container ---------- */
section[class*="panel-container"]:not([class*="transparent"]) {
  background-color: var(--ui-card) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-panel) !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-card-shadow) !important;
}

/* ---------- Panel Title ---------- */
[class*="panel-title"] {
  color: var(--ui-muted-fg) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
}

/* ---------- Padding ---------- */
[data-testid="data-testid dashboard controls"] {
  padding: 4px 0 8px 0 !important;
}

[class*="-canvas-wrapper-old"] [class*="-body"] {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin-top: -32px !important;
}

/* ---------- Dashboard Variable Controls ---------- */
[class*="submenu-controls"],
[class*="SubMenu"] {
  background-color: var(--ui-bg) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
  z-index: 10 !important;
  position: relative !important;
  padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px !important;
}

/* Variable Container */
[data-testid="data-testid template variable"] {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 0 !important;
}

/* Variable Label */
[data-testid="data-testid template variable"]>label {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  color: var(--ui-muted-fg) !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  padding: 0 8px 0 0 !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

/* Variable Dropdown - Outer Wrapper */
[data-testid="data-testid template variable"] [class*="-input-wrapper"] {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-fill) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-select-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-select) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-select-shadow) !important;
  min-height: 32px !important;
  transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid template variable"] [class*="-input-wrapper"]:hover {
  border-color: var(--ui-select-hover-border) !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid template variable"] [class*="-input-wrapper"]:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--ui-select-outstanding) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-select-focus-ring) !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

/* Variable Dropdown - Inner Container */
[data-testid="data-testid template variable"] [class*="-input-wrapper"]>div:not([class*="input-suffix"]):not([class*="a11yText"]) {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: inherit !important;
}

/* Variable Value Container */
[data-testid="data-testid template variable"] [class*="select-value-container"] {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  padding: 0 8px !important;
}

/* Variable Selected Value */
div[class*="singleValue"],
div[class*="grafana-select-value-container"] {
  color: var(--ui-select-text) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
}

/* Variable Dropdown Arrow */
div[class*="input-suffix"] {
  color: var(--ui-muted-fg) !important;
  padding-right: 8px !important;
}

div[class*="input-suffix"] svg {
  fill: var(--ui-muted-fg) !important;
}

/* Variable Dropdown Menu (expanded) */
div[class*="menu"],
[class*="options-group"] {
  z-index: 1050 !important;
  background-color: var(--ui-menu-fill) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-menu-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-select) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-menu-shadow) !important;
  padding: 4px !important;
}

/* Dropdown Options */
[data-testid="data-testid Select option"] {
  color: var(--ui-select-text) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
  height: 32px !important;
  min-height: 32px !important;
  max-height: 32px !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  padding: 6px 8px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  border-left: 2px solid transparent !important;
  outline: none !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"]:hover {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-hover-fill) !important;
  color: var(--ui-select-text-strong) !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"][class*="focused"] {
  color: var(--ui-select-text-strong) !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  border-left-color: transparent !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"][aria-selected="true"] {
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
  background-color: var(--ui-select-selected-fill) !important;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ui-primary) !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"][aria-selected="true"][class*="focused"] {
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
  background-color: var(--ui-select-selected-fill) !important;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ui-primary) !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"] [class*="option-body"] {
  padding: 0 !important;
  height: 20px !important;
  min-height: 20px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"]::before,
[data-testid="data-testid Select option"]::after {
  background-image: none !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* ---------- Legacy Select ---------- */
.gf-form-select-box__control,
div[class*="gf-form-select-box__control"] {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-fill) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-select-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-select) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-select-shadow) !important;
  min-height: 32px !important;
  transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease !important;
}

.gf-form-select-box__control:hover,
div[class*="gf-form-select-box__control"]:hover {
  border-color: var(--ui-select-hover-border) !important;
}

.gf-form-select-box__control--is-focused,
div[class*="gf-form-select-box__control--is-focused"] {
  border-color: var(--ui-select-outstanding) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-select-focus-ring) !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

.gf-form-select-box__menu {
  background-color: var(--ui-menu-fill) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-menu-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-select) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--ui-menu-shadow) !important;
  padding: 4px !important;
}

.gf-form-select-box__option {
  color: var(--ui-select-text) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-left: 2px solid transparent !important;
  border-image: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  padding: 6px 8px !important;
}

div.gf-form-select-box__option.gf-form-select-box__option--is-focused,
div.gf-form-select-box__option.gf-form-select-box__option--is-selected {
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
  background-color: var(--ui-select-selected-fill) !important;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ui-primary) !important;
  border-image: none !important;
}

.gf-form-select-box__option--is-selected .fa {
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
}

[data-testid="data-testid Select option"] *,
.gf-form-select-box__option * {
  border-radius: 0 !important;
}

/* ---------- Native Grafana Menus ---------- */
[role="menu"] [role="menuitem"],
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemradio"],
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemcheckbox"],
button[data-role="menuitem"] {
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-menu-item) !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  color: var(--ui-select-text) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
  min-height: 32px !important;
  height: 32px !important;
  padding: 6px 8px !important;
  outline: none !important;
  transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease !important;
}

[role="menu"] [role="menuitem"]:hover,
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemradio"]:hover,
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemcheckbox"]:hover,
button[data-role="menuitem"]:hover,
[role="menu"] [role="menuitem"]:focus-visible,
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemradio"]:focus-visible,
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemcheckbox"]:focus-visible,
button[data-role="menuitem"]:focus-visible {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-hover-fill) !important;
  color: var(--ui-select-text-strong) !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

[role="menu"] [role="menuitem"][aria-checked="true"],
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemradio"][aria-checked="true"],
[role="menu"] [role="menuitemcheckbox"][aria-checked="true"],
button[data-role="menuitem"][aria-checked="true"] {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-selected-fill) !important;
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
}

/* ---------- Time Picker Menu ---------- */
[aria-roledescription="Time range selection"] li {
  height: 32px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
}

[aria-roledescription="Time range selection"] label {
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-menu-item) !important;
  color: var(--ui-select-text) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  height: 32px !important;
  line-height: 20px !important;
  padding: 6px 8px !important;
  transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease !important;
}

[aria-roledescription="Time range selection"] li:hover label,
[aria-roledescription="Time range selection"] li:focus-within label {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-hover-fill) !important;
  color: var(--ui-select-text-strong) !important;
}

[aria-roledescription="Time range selection"] input:checked + label {
  background-color: var(--ui-select-selected-fill) !important;
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
}

/* ---------- Time Picker / Toolbar Buttons ---------- */
button[class*="toolbar-button"],
button[data-testid="data-testid TimePicker Open Button"],
.button-group > button {
  background-color: var(--ui-card) !important;
  color: var(--ui-fg) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-button) !important;
}

/* Button Group Connectors */
.button-group {
  gap: 0 !important;
}

.button-group > button:first-child {
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-button) 0 0 var(--ui-radius-button) !important;
  border-right: none !important;
}

.button-group > button:last-child {
  border-radius: 0 var(--ui-radius-button) var(--ui-radius-button) 0 !important;
}

/* ---------- Refresh Picker ---------- */
[class*="refresh-picker"] > button,
[class*="RefreshPicker"] > button {
  background-color: var(--ui-card) !important;
  color: var(--ui-fg) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
}

[class*="refresh-picker"] > div:last-child > button,
[class*="RefreshPicker"] > div:last-child > button {
  border-radius: 0 var(--ui-radius-button) var(--ui-radius-button) 0 !important;
}

/* ---------- Top Navigation ---------- */
[class*="navbar"],
header[class*="page-toolbar"] {
  background-color: var(--ui-card) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
}

/* ---------- Inputs / Selects ---------- */
input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]),
select,
[class*="gf-form-input"] {
  border-color: var(--ui-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-input) !important;
  color: var(--ui-fg) !important;
}

/* ---------- Tables ---------- */
table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-input) 15%, transparent) !important;
}

table tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: var(--ui-table-hover) !important;
}

[class*="tableContentWrapper"] div[class*="row"]:hover,
[class*="tablePanel"] div[class*="row"]:hover {
  background-color: var(--ui-table-hover) !important;
  transition: background-color 120ms ease !important;
}

table th {
  color: var(--ui-muted-fg) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
}

/* ---------- Links ---------- */
a:not([class*="btn"]):not([class*="variable"]) {
  color: var(--ui-primary) !important;
}

/* ---------- Row Title ---------- */
.dashboard-row .dashboard-row__title {
  color: var(--ui-fg) !important;
}

/* ---------- Tooltip ---------- */
[class*="tooltip"]:not([class*="panel"]) {
  background-color: var(--ui-card) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius) !important;
  color: var(--ui-fg) !important;
}

/* ---------- Alert ---------- */
[class*="alert-error"],
[class*="alerting"] {
  border-color: var(--ui-destructive) !important;
}

/* ---------- Scrollbar ---------- */
html,
body,
#root {
  scrollbar-width: none !important;
}

html::-webkit-scrollbar,
body::-webkit-scrollbar,
#root::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0 !important;
  height: 0 !important;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--ui-input);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--ui-muted-fg);
}

/* Hide the injected theme panel itself */
div[data-griditem-key="grid-item-9999"] {
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

</style>

panels.description: End to end request latency measured in seconds.
panels.title: E2E Request Latency

panels.description: Number of tokens processed per second
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Inter token latency in seconds. Uses inter_token_latency_seconds (v0.11.2+) with fallback to time_per_output_token_seconds (v0.8.5).
panels.title: Time Per Output Token Latency

panels.description: Number of requests in RUNNING, WAITING, and SWAPPED state. Note: vLLM v1 engine (v0.11.2+) has no swap mechanism, so Num Swapped will show no data.
panels.title: Scheduler State

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, and P99 TTFT latency in seconds.
panels.title: Time To First Token Latency

panels.description: Percentage of used cache blocks by vLLM. Note: vLLM v1 engine (v0.11.2+) has no CPU cache, so CPU Cache Usage will show no data.
panels.title: Cache Utilization

panels.description: Number of finished requests by their finish reason: either an EOS token was generated or the max sequence length was reached.
panels.title: Finish Reason
Max Generation Token in Sequence Group
